snippet.title: Fortnite OG: Chapter 1 - Season 1 OG Pass Trailer
snippet.description:
Time for some serious nostalgia. The Fortnite OG Pass features 45 tiers of retro rewards with a modern twist on classic items and Outfits. Renegade Rebel, Aerial Assault Bomber, and Skull Commander are the Outfits to earn in Season 1, with an unlockable alt style for each. 

The Chapter 1 - Season 1 OG Pass, which can be levelled up with XP earned from playing any experience in Fortnite, will be available to complete until January 31, 2025, at 2 AM ET!
